text:
marta: FYI post-deploy anomaly on canary tier, rolling error spike and mem growth starting ~10m after rollout. Seeing OOMs on 3 pods in eu-west-1.
incident-bot: Paging on-call: @shiv (pager duty). Incident created: INC-2026-0923-17. Severity: high.
shiv: acknowledged, joining. @marta can you paste the rollout ID and the commit/PR?
marta: rollout id r-2026-09-23-11:22, PR #4783 (model-routing: prefer-variant-b fallback). Commit sha: b3f9c2a. Quick diff looks small but shows new routing logic + cache header.
kai: I’m on-call fallback, available to help with rollback if needed. Do we have customer-facing failures?
marta: Yes — 5% increased 5xx rate for hosted API customers hitting short-context generation. Top affected model route: /v1/generate?model=redwood-v1-small. Errors are "kvcache OOM" in runtime logs. Estimated affected requests ~1200 over 12m, highest in eu-west-1.
lee: Can we flip the feature flag for the routing tweak? Which flag name?
marta: Flag is `feat/model_variant_fallback_v2`. I can kill it if we want quick mitigation.
shiv: Let's kill flag first to avoid full rollout revert. Kai, can you coordinate the flag kill and validate? I’ll prepare a revert PR in parallel.
kai: On it — hitting the console now. Changing flag to off for all environments (will roll out to eu-west first).
incident-bot: Flag change requested by kai. 3 minute cooldown in effect.
(3m later)
kai: Flag off. Monitoring. I see immediate drop in OOM traces on the affected pods. 5xx rate falling from 5% -> 1.2% in eu-west-1.
marta: Good. Creating a fast patch to revert the single problematic commit and push a hotfix tag. I’ll open a PR with the revert cherry-pick.
shiv: Add test/coverage on the fallback code path so we don't re-introduce. Also annotate the PR with rollback rationale and incident link.
marta: PR opened: #4790 — "revert: model-routing fallback change (b3f9c2a)". CI green. Plan: merge to release branch, create v2026.09.23-hotfix, then deploy canary to eu-west-1, then promote.
lee: Do we need a canary kill-switch if the hotfix somehow regresses? We should prepare switch & kill flag for the hotfix too.
shiv: Good call. Kai, pre-create the hotfix feature flag `hotfix/2026-09-23-revert-4783` and set default off; we'll turn on for eu-west canary after deploy.
kai: Done. Flag created. Deployment window scheduled now: +12m. I'm standing by to flip it.
(prepare deploy)
marta: Deploy started: rolling canary to 10% eu-west-1. Deploy ID dpl-2026-09-23-HF1. Commands used: ``git checkout release && git merge --no-ff b3f9c2a^! && git tag v2026.09.23-hotfix && kubectl apply -f k8s/hotfix-deploy.yaml``.
sarah: Observability: adding short-term alert to watch mem-usage and 5xxs for route `/v1/generate` for next 30m.
(4m into canary)
kai: Hotfix canary on. Flipping `hotfix/2026-09-23-revert-4783` flag to ON for canary pods.
lee: Metrics: 5xxs back to baseline ~0.3% on the canary nodes, mem stable. No new OOMs in the last 6m.
shiv: Merge #4790 to release branch done. Promote to full rollout after 15m of stable canary. Keep flag as kill-switch if needed.
marta: Noting customer impact for postmortem: ~1200 requests errored (eu-west) affecting ~40 unique API keys. No incident SLA breach but potential degraded UX. We'll notify customers in the incident status page (ops will handle messaging).
incident-bot: Incident status updated to: Mitigated. Pager cleared for @shiv.
kai: Handoff to runbook: monitor for 1h, then close. Follow-ups: coverage test for fallback path, add rate-limiter to avoid cache spikes, add regression test in e2e for long-seq KV cache usage.
lee: I’ll open follow-up tickets and assign owners. Ticket IDs: OPS-1021 (customer-notice), ENG-2045 (regression test), ENG-2046 (rate-limiter).
shiv: Good job everyone. Root cause hypothesis: routing change introduced a cache key explosion for a subset of request shapes, causing memory blowups in continuous batching path. We'll confirm in postmortem.
marta: Final note — the revert was a single-commit revert, no DB changes, no schema drift. Closing incident in 1hr unless new regressions.
sarah: Confirming logs show no further OOM traces in eu-west over last 20m. I’ll post graphs to the incident doc.
kai: Handing off to morning oncall for follow-up. Oncall tomorrow: @lee.
lee: Acknowledged; taking follow-up. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
